placements.why: Establishes a dedicated organizational reliability category centered on active drill cadences and verified recovery mechanisms.
placements.title: Operational recovery capabilities require active verification rather than assumed readiness
placements.frame: How does the organization systematically test, verify, and sustain its operational recovery and reliability mechanisms?

placements.title: Recovery mechanisms only exist to the extent they are routinely rehearsed
placements.frame: Does the team treat operational recovery mechanisms as nonexistent until actively proven through regular rehearsal?
placements.why: Quinton mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals based on the foundational premise that unpracticed rollbacks do not functionally exist.
